Short title and commencement

THE CONSTITUTION (THIRD AMENDMENT), 1965
THE CONSTITUTION
(THIRD AMENDMENT), 1965.
ACT No. IV of 1965
(For Statement of Objects and
Reasons, see Gaz. of P., 1965, Ext., p. 341.)
[16th June,
1965]
An Act further to
amend the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan.
1. Short title and commencement----(1)
This Act may be called the Constitution (Third Amendment) Act, 1965.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of Article 103 of the constitution

THE CONSTITUTION (THIRD AMENDMENT), 1965
THE CONSTITUTION
(THIRD AMENDMENT), 1965.
ACT No. IV of 1965
(For Statement of Objects and
Reasons, see Gaz. of P., 1965, Ext., p. 341.)
[16th June,
1965]
An Act further to
amend the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan.
2. Amendment of Article 103 of
the constitution---------In the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of
Pakistan, hereinafter referred to as the Constitution, in Article 103, in
clause (2), in paragraph (a), after the word " Pakistan ", the words
" other than an office specified in the Fifth Schedule " shall be
added and shall be deemed always to have been so added.

Amendment of Article 104 of the Constitution

ACT No. IV of 1965
(For Statement of Objects and

[16th June,
1965]
An Act further to
amend the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan.
3. Amendment of Article 104 of
the Constitution------In the Constitution, in Article 104, in clause (1),
after the words " service of Pakistan", the words " not being an
office specified in the Fifth Schedule", shall be inserted.

Addition of Fifth Schedule to the Constitution

THE CONSTITUTION (THIRD AMENDMENT), 1965
THE CONSTITUTION
(THIRD AMENDMENT), 1965.
ACT No. IV of 1965
(For Statement of Objects and
Reasons, see Gaz. of P., 1965, Ext., p. 341.)
[16th June,
1965]
An Act further to
amend the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan.
4. Addition of Fifth Schedule
to the Constitution------In the Constitution, after the Fourth Schedule,
the following new Schedule shall be added and shall be deemed always to have
been so added, namely :------
"FIFTH
SCHEDULE
[Articles 103 (2)
(a) and 104 (1)]
1. An office which is not a
whole-time office remunerated either by salary or by fee.
2. The offices of Lambardar,
Inamdar, Sufedposh and Zaildar, whether called by this or any other title.
3. The offices of the Chairmen of
the Union Council, Union Committee and Town Committee and of the Vice-Chairmen
of the Municipal Committee and the District Council.
4. Reserves of the Armed Forces
:-
(1) The Pakistan Army
(i) The Pakistan Army Regular
Reserve of Officers.
(ii) The Pakistan Army Regular
Reserve of Junior Commissioned Officers.
(iii) They Pakistan Army
Supplementary Re serve of Officers.
(iv) The Pakistan Army
Supplementary Reserve of Junior Commissioned Officers and Other Ranks.
(v) The Regular Reserves of Other
Ranks.
(2) The Pakistan Navy ;
(i) The Pakistan Naval Volunteer
Reserve,
(ii) The Pakistan Naval Reserve.
(iii) The Naval Reservists
(Ratings).
(3) The Pakistan Air Force
(i) The Pakistan Air Force
Regular Reserve.
(ii) The Pakistan Air Force Volunteer Reserve.
5. The Ansars raised under the Ansars
Act, 1948 (East Bengal Act VI1 of 1948).
6. Any office the holder whereof,
by virtue of hold ing such office, is liable to be called up for mili tary
training or military service under any law pro viding for the constitution or
raising of a force.
7. Any other office which is
declared by an Act the Central Legislature not to disqualify its hold er from
being elected as, or from being a member of an Assembly. ".

Validation

THE CONSTITUTION (THIRD AMENDMENT), 1965
THE CONSTITUTION
(THIRD AMENDMENT), 1965.
ACT No. IV of 1965
(For Statement of Objects and
Reasons, see Gaz. of P., 1965, Ext., p. 341.)
[16th June,
1965]
An Act further to
amend the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan.
5. Validation----------A
person holding any of the offices specified in the Fifth Schedule to the
Constitution as added by this Act who has been elected as a member of an
Assembly before the commence ment of this Act shall not be, and shall be deemed
never to have been, disqualified from being elected as, and from being, a
member of an Assembly, and, notwithstanding anything in the: Constitution, the
election of any such person shall not be ques tioned merely on the ground that
he held any such office at the time when he was elected.
